new_claims.statement: For every original-coordinate cross block M with E4(M)>0, either an entropy-biased fourth-volume deletion flow produces triple marginals <=2/3 and ||p_Q||inf <= (9 sqrt(3)e/2)(E4/||M||F^2)^(-1/6), or one physical four-row packet U has d_U>(2/3)E4 and account02/B04 plus E3(M_U)>=4d_U^(3/4) gives ||p_Q||inf<6((2/3)E4)^(-1/8). Both branches give C0 densities.

For arbitrary deletion kernel kappa from canonical fourth-volume bases, with induced triple law mu and uniform-deletion law mu0, G(mu)=4E4 exp(-KL(mu||mu0))/tau_geo(mu), and KL(mu||mu0)<=E_R KL(kappa_R||Unif4).
A deletion kernel with all induced triple row marginals <=2/3 exists iff sum_{i in U}(rho_i-2/3)_+ <= P(R intersects U) for every U; if it fails, some four-row U has P(R=U)>2/3.

partner_result_actually_applied.application: In the heavy four-row packet branch, N=M_U,* has exactly four physical rows, so every triple law has some marginal >=3/4. Applying the partner theorem and E3(N)>=4d_U^(3/4) yields ||p_Q||inf<=6d_U^(-1/8)<6((2/3)E4)^(-1/8). Also applied to dense H4/2 endpoint, giving bound 6.
